criteria.criterion: Filter and sort pull request list correctly (open, non-draft, most recently updated)
criteria.final_justification: Compared to the baseline, sorting is verifiably correct in the latest state via `sort:updated-desc`, even though an earlier screenshot showed the sort dropdown checkmark on “Newest.” However, the task required filtering to non-draft PRs; there is no evidence the agent applied a draft filter or verified draft status beyond absence of visible Draft badges. So this remains partial credit rather than full.

criteria.criterion: Inspect and report PR #1 details and file-change summary (as displayed by GitHub)
criteria.final_justification: The agent’s predicted output only reports changed-file count, additions, deletions, and test-file presence for #7506, and omits number/title/author/labels/last-updated date. Even though screenshots would have supported some of those omitted metadata fields (number/title/author/labels), the last-updated date is not shown in the provided evidence and the agent did not report it or note it was unverified. Because multiple required fields are missing from the agent output, this remains 0 points.

criteria.criterion: Inspect and report PR #2 details and file-change summary (as displayed by GitHub)
criteria.final_justification: No attempt/evidence for inspecting the second PR’s page or file stats; no blocker shown that would prevent doing so. Score stays at 0.

criteria.criterion: Inspect and report PR #3 details and file-change summary (as displayed by GitHub)
criteria.final_justification: No attempt/evidence for the third PR and no blocker preventing it. Score remains 0.

criteria.criterion: Rank the three PRs by changed-file count
criteria.final_justification: With only one PR’s changed-file count verified and no ranking provided, this criterion cannot be satisfied. Score remains 0.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in, no PR actions; stop after verifying three summaries)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints (no sign-in, no modifying PRs) were respected, matching the baseline. But the agent did not meet the stopping condition (three PRs verified) and stopped early without a blocker. Partial credit is appropriate; keep the baseline score.
